perks.name: Light Mag

  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Accurized Rounds

  •  Increases range

perks.name: Tactical Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has multiple tactical improvements.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases magazine size

perks.name: Drop Mag
perks.desc: Increases reload speed but reduces magazine size.

perks.name: Steady Rounds
perks.desc:
This magazine is optimized for recoil control.
  •  Greatly increases stability 
  •  Slightly decreases range
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Hip-Fire Grip
perks.desc: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

perks.name: To the Pain
perks.desc:
While this weapon is equipped, taking damage increases handling and aim assist until the weapon is stowed.

Taking more damage increases the effect.

perks.name: Subsistence
perks.desc: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.desc: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Encore
perks.desc: Final blows grant a stacking stability, range, and accuracy bonus to this weapon. Precision final blows grant more stacks.

perks.name: Pugilist
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

perks.name: Offhand Strike
perks.desc: Final blows grant additional weapon range, stability, and accuracy when firing from the hip for a short duration.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.desc: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: Tap the Trigger
perks.desc: Grants a short period of increased stability and accuracy on initial trigger pull.

perks.name: Adagio
perks.desc: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for a brief time.

perks.name: Killing Wind
perks.desc: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for a short duration.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

perks.name: Tex Balanced Stock
perks.desc: Damaging targets while firing from the hip increases handling, reload speed, and movement speed while aiming down sights.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 136 from 1 April 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/6I828LxsIqdth4iIlSYRmG?si=8022df8ede664223) with @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for dealing with Minor adds in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content, particularly with melee builds. Boondoggle Mk. 55 has been dubbed the legendary Huckleberry for PvP but it still has some utility in PvE if you've not yet acquired an SMG in your vault, or you prefer to hipfire weapons. At base, by comparison with its peers, the stats are competitive - 47 Range equates to 18.70m ADS and 13.36m hipfire before damage dropoff, 15 Stability is ×1.0859 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 52 Handling is 0.35s ready, 0.26s ADS and 0.32s stow speed, 21 Reload Speed is a 2.25s reload, Recoil Direction is 96, Zoom is 14, and magazine size is 30 (max 38). For controller, Stability is probably the top priority for the barrel perk, but if you can handle the recoil extra handling is nice. Similarly, with the magazine perk aim to boost Reload Speed, although the combat effect perks are also decent. For a melee-focused build, Boondoggle is the only SMG to have the trait perk combination of Pugilist to gain melee ability energy on kills and boost handling, and Swashbuckler for ×1.33 damage for 4.5s (6.5s when enhanced) at five stacks or after a melee kill. If you're interested, a "Boondoggle" is an unnecessary, wasteful or fraudulent project. The Tex Balanced Stock is only of value if you hipfire, but if you do, there's a refreshable buff after getting 4 hits, that grants +20 Range, Handling and Reload Speed, a ×0.9 reload animation multiplier, a 1.5° larger precision cone and a 10% decreased ADS movement penalty. Recommended MW: Stability or Handling, with a Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create power orbs or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader. Also, don't forget to check whether there's a useful Seasonal Fragile mod for the activity you're running.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "You should get a Boondoggle Mk.55 just for the name alone. Outside of the name you have the standard low stat aggressive frame submachine gun. Subsistence is the best reload perk and Adagio, while lowering the RPM has the best damage increase." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): "Aggressive frame submachine guns shine brighter in PvP where their lower stability stats can usually be bumped with perks that supplement instead of fighting for damage perks. To the Pain increases your aim assist while you're fighting, whereas Closing Time only assists as your magazine gets lower. Hip-Fire Grip is also another option if you run-and-gun a lot. Tap the Trigger is gonna be the best for keeping accuracy as the stability is already pretty low to begin with." Recommended MW: Stability.
